cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore && ls __agent_eval__ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/ 2>/dev/null && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/i18n/ 2>/dev/null && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/ 2>/dev/null

cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/i18n.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/index.d.ts; echo ----; grep -n "configure\|Lang\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/i18n/en.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/i18n/ru.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | head -80

node -e "const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json');console.log(Object.keys(p.exports))"; ls node_modules | grep -i "jsdom\|happy-dom\|testing-library"; grep -n "label_\|button_" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/TableColumnSetup/i18n/en.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog/i18n/en.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Alert/i18n/en.json 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/Select.d.ts | grep -n "hasClear\|filterable\|placeholder" | head

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts; sed -i "s/          controlProps={{ 'aria-labelledby': 'demo-fruit-label' }}/          aria-labelledby=\"demo-fruit-label\"/" src/App.tsx && sed -i 's/<SegmentedRadioGroup.Option key={lang} value={lang} qa={`language-option-${lang}`}>/<SegmentedRadioGroup.Option key={lang} value={lang}>/' src/components/LanguageSwitcher.tsx && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json; echo "TSC_EXIT=$?"

(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npm ls -g playwright 2>/dev/null | grep playwright; node -e "require.resolve('playwright')" 2>&1 | head -1) ; echo ----; git status --short; echo ----; cat .gitignore

rm -rf dist && printf 'node_modules/
__agent_eval__/
dist/
' > .gitignore && git status --short; echo ----; timeout 25 npm view jsdom version 2>&1 | tail -2; timeout 25 npm view @testing-library/react version 2>&1 | tail -2
timeout 240 npm install --save-dev jsdom@30 @testing-library/react@16 @testing-library/dom@10 @testing-library/user-event@14 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "NPM_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

perl -0pi -e "s/expect\(screen\.getByRole\('heading', \{ level: 1 \}\)\)\.toHaveTextContent\(\s*'([^']*)',\s*\);/expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 }).textContent).toBe('\$1');/g; s/\.toBeChecked\(\);/.toHaveProperty('checked', true);/g" src/App.test.tsx && grep -n "toHaveTextContent\|toBeChecked" src/App.test.tsx; npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -25

npx vitest run src/App.test.tsx 2>&1 | grep -n "FAIL\|Error:\|Unable to find\|✓\|×" | head -20; echo ----; grep -n "button_next\|button_previous\|aria-label\|title" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/components/PaginationButton/PaginationButton.js | head -20
